command:
set -euo pipefail
LA="$HOME/local-agent"
BASE="334a6c373b179061dd8cb544743b26fae34c4e50"
WT="/private/tmp/local-agent-chat-bridge-wake-only-v45"
BR="chat-bridge-wake-only-v45"

test "$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
git -C "$LA" fetch --quiet origin main
test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE"

if [ -d "$WT" ]; then git -C "$LA" worktree remove --force "$WT"; fi
if git -C "$LA" show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$BR"; then git -C "$LA" branch -D "$BR"; fi
git -C "$LA" worktree add -b "$BR" "$WT" "$BASE" >/dev/null
cd "$WT"

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json

def replace_once(path, old, new):
    p = Path(path)
    text = p.read_text()
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"{path}: expected one match, got {count}")
    p.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))

replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/bridge_state.js",
    """  function sanitizeRepositoryId(value) {
    return String(value || "").trim().slice(0, 120);
  }

""",
    "",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/bridge_state.js",
    '      repositoryId: sanitizeRepositoryId(raw.repositoryId),\n',
    "",
)

replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/service_worker.js",
    """function buildBootstrapPrompt(runtime, conversation) {
  const hints = [
    "Bridge v0.3 controls are conversation-scoped. Prefer short final-line controls: [LAB:STOP], [LAB:PAUSE], [LAB:RESUME], [LAB:NEXT=30s], [LAB:NEXT=10m], [LAB:INTERVAL=30m], [LAB:INTERVAL=AUTO]. NEXT arms or re-arms this conversation and changes only its next wake, not the normal interval or global master switch."
  ];
  if (conversation.label) hints.push(`Bridge label: ${conversation.label}.`);
  if (conversation.repositoryId) {
    hints.push(`Configured Local Agent repository id: ${conversation.repositoryId}.`);
  }
  return `${runtime.bootstrapPrompt}\\n${hints.join(" ")}`;
}
""",
    """function buildBootstrapPrompt(runtime) {
  return `${runtime.bootstrapPrompt}\\nBridge controls are conversation-scoped. Continue only the active goal of this conversation. The bridge only schedules wake-ups and does not choose or route repositories. Prefer short final-line controls: [LAB:STOP], [LAB:PAUSE], [LAB:RESUME], [LAB:NEXT=30s], [LAB:NEXT=10m], [LAB:INTERVAL=30m], [LAB:INTERVAL=AUTO]. NEXT arms or re-arms this conversation and changes only its next wake, not the normal interval or global master switch.`;
}
""",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/service_worker.js",
    "    ? buildBootstrapPrompt(runtime, conversation)\n",
    "    ? buildBootstrapPrompt(runtime)\n",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/service_worker.js",
    """    const previous = state.conversations[id];
    const repositoryChanged =
      previous && String(previous.repositoryId || "") !== String(patch.repositoryId || "");
    const upserted = stateModel.upsertConversation(state, {
      ...patch,
      url,
      bootstrapPending: previous ? previous.bootstrapPending || repositoryChanged : true
    });
""",
    """    const previous = state.conversations[id];
    const upserted = stateModel.upsertConversation(state, {
      ...patch,
      url,
      bootstrapPending: previous ? previous.bootstrapPending : true
    });
""",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/service_worker.js",
    '    const previousRepositoryId = String(previous.repositoryId || "");\n',
    "",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/service_worker.js",
    """    if ("repositoryId" in patch) {
      safePatch.repositoryId = patch.repositoryId;
      if (previousRepositoryId !== String(patch.repositoryId || "")) {
        safePatch.bootstrapPending = true;
      }
    }
""",
    "",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/service_worker.js",
    '        repositoryChanged: previousRepositoryId !== String(updated.conversation.repositoryId || ""),\n',
    "",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/service_worker.js",
    "  } else if (result.value?.enabledChanged || result.value?.repositoryChanged) {\n",
    "  } else if (result.value?.enabledChanged) {\n",
)

replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/popup.js",
    """  const repoWrap = document.createElement("div");
  const repoLabel = document.createElement("label");
  repoLabel.textContent = "Repository id (optional)";
  const repoInput = createTextInput(conversation.repositoryId, "optional routing hint");
  repoWrap.append(repoLabel, repoInput);

""",
    "",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/popup.js",
    "  grid.append(labelWrap, repoWrap, intervalWrap);\n",
    "  grid.append(labelWrap, intervalWrap);\n",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/popup.js",
    "          repositoryId: repoInput.value,\n",
    "",
)
replace_once(
    "chat_bridge/popup.js",
    '      repositoryId: existing?.repositoryId || "",\n',
    "",
)

for path in ("chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js", "chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js"):
    p = Path(path)
    p.write_text("".join(line for line in p.read_text().splitlines(True) if "repositoryId:" not in line))

p = Path("chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js")
text = p.read_text()
needle = 'assert.equal(state.conversations[aId].bootstrapPending, true);\n'
if needle not in text:
    raise SystemExit("bridge_state.test.js insertion point missing")
text = text.replace(
    needle,
    needle + 'assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(state.conversations[aId], "repositoryId"), false);\n',
    1,
)
p.write_text(text)

p = Path("chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js")
text = p.read_text()
needle = "  assert.equal(response.ok, true);\n  const bId = response.conversation.id;\n"
if needle not in text:
    raise SystemExit("service_worker.test.js bId insertion point missing")
text = text.replace(
    needle,
    '  assert.equal(response.ok, true);\n  assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(response.conversation, "repositoryId"), false);\n  const bId = response.conversation.id;\n',
    1,
)
needle = r"  assert.match(sentMessages.at(-1).message.prompt, /\[LAB:NEXT=30s\]/);" + "\n"
if needle not in text:
    raise SystemExit("service_worker.test.js bootstrap assertion point missing")
text = text.replace(
    needle,
    needle
    + '  assert.doesNotMatch(sentMessages.at(-1).message.prompt, /repository id/i);\n'
    + '  assert.doesNotMatch(sentMessages.at(-1).message.prompt, /Project B/);\n',
    1,
)
p.write_text(text)

p = Path("chat_bridge/README.md")
text = p.read_text()
replacements = [
    (
        "- each conversation can store an automatically detected label and optional Local Agent `repositoryId` routing hint;\n",
        "- each conversation stores only wake/scheduling state plus an optional UI label; repository routing remains entirely in the conversation/planner context;\n",
    ),
    (
        "The default compact prompt is intentionally short:\n",
        "The default compact prompt is intentionally short and repository-agnostic:\n",
    ),
    (
        "- one card per configured conversation with editable label, optional repository id, enable/pause, manual interval override, `Run now`, save and remove actions;\n",
        "- one card per configured conversation with editable label, enable/pause, manual interval override, `Run now`, save and remove actions;\n",
    ),
    (
        "\nThe repository id cannot be derived reliably from a ChatGPT conversation URL, so it is intentionally optional. Changing it later marks that conversation's bootstrap as pending so the new routing hint is delivered once before compact wake mode resumes.\n",
        "\nThe bridge deliberately does not store or send repository routing. It only wakes the exact configured conversation; that conversation determines its active goal and target repository from its own context and fresh evidence.\n",
    ),
    (
        "7. Edit the optional repository id only when a planner routing hint is useful.\n8. Use **Run now** on a conversation card for an end-to-end test.\n",
        "7. Use **Run now** on a conversation card for an end-to-end test.\n",
    ),
]
for old, new in replacements:
    if old not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f"README replacement point missing: {old[:60]!r}")
    text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(text)

p = Path("chat_bridge/manifest.json")
data = json.loads(p.read_text())
if data.get("version") != "0.3.1":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected manifest version: {data.get('version')}")
data["version"] = "0.3.2"
p.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")
PY

if grep -R -n -E 'repositoryId|repository id|routing hint' chat_bridge; then
  echo "Unexpected repository routing residue" >&2
  exit 1
fi

node --check chat_bridge/control_protocol.js
node --check chat_bridge/bridge_state.js
node --check chat_bridge/control_protocol.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/service_worker.js
node --check chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/content.js
node --check chat_bridge/popup.js
node chat_bridge/control_protocol.test.js
node chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js
node chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js
python3 -m json.tool chat_bridge/manifest.json >/dev/null
python3 -m json.tool chat_bridge/runtime.example.json >/dev/null
git diff --check

git add chat_bridge
git commit -m "Simplify Chat Bridge to wake-only transport" >/dev/null
CANDIDATE="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
git push --quiet -u origin "$BR"
echo "CANDIDATE_SHA=$CANDIDATE"
echo "WAKE_ONLY_BRIDGE_TESTS=PASS"
